$comment: Allowlist by ID for the known-red tests (R11 / D-0). Not a suppression: `npm run test:gate` fails if any of these PASSES (the entry became stale) and also fails on any failure that is NOT listed here. Editing this file is a deliberate act that the git history records.
rationale: P1.3 is documented NOT DONE in BACKLOG.md:119 and blocked by ADR-021 (status: Proposed). next-activity-selector.ts reads node.metadata['skills']/['newSkills'] which curriculum-parser.ts never populates, iPlus1Score is a constant 0, and getFsrsPriorityForLesson() is `return 0`. The 5 failures below are deterministic (reproduced identically in every measured run), so they are the expected state until ADR-021 is decided and P1.3 is implemented.
